newsitem.title: USA: Dupont Q3 share net seen over estimates.
newsitem.headline: Dupont Q3 share net seen over estimates.

text.p: DuPont Co said Thursday third quarter earnings per share excluding nonrecurring items are expected to be at least 10 percent above the current average of analysts' estimates of about $1.45 per share.
"Strong results in the company's upstream petroleum operations are the major factor in this improved outlook," said chief executive John A. Krol.
Petroleum segment results are expected to exceed last year's third quarter by over 40 percent, mainly due to higher worldwide crude oil prices, DuPont said.
A number of chemicals and specialties businesses also are expected to contribute to this improvement, most notably agricultural products.

The company also announced a third quarter nonrecurring charge of about $50 million after taxes, or $0.09 per share, for crop damage claims and legal expenses related to the recall of Benlate 50 DF fungicide.
DuPont said it plans to release third quarter 1996 earnings on October 23. -- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710.
